harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9.6) using binary release install + systemd units, with firewalld opened for peer/client ports 2380/2379. Verified cross-member read/write replication, verified continued read/write availability with one member down and that member's automatic catch-up on rejoin, then performed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol on all three nodes (one at a time, quorum preserved), confirming changed boot IDs and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed etcd/etcdctl/etcdutl v3.5.17 binaries on node1, node2, node3 from official GitHub release tarball
Created etcd system user, /var/lib/etcd data dir, and per-node systemd unit files with static 3-member --initial-cluster configuration
Opened firewalld ports 2379/tcp (client) and 2380/tcp (peer) permanently on all three nodes
Started etcd on all three nodes simultaneously to bootstrap the cluster; confirmed 3/3 healthy members via member list, endpoint health, endpoint status
Wrote key 'benchkey' via node1 and confirmed it was readable from node2 and node3 (cross-member replication)
Stopped etcd on node3 to simulate a member outage, then wrote key 'duringoutage' via node1 and read it via node2, proving the cluster keeps serving reads/writes with one member down
Restarted etcd on node3 and confirmed it caught up to the same raft applied index as the other two members and had both keys present
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, uptime, etcd active status, key reads) on all three nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 (one at a time via native reboot, backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect), polling each until reachable again
Confirmed each node's boot_id changed after its restart, proving a true OS reboot occurred (not just a service restart)

After each node's reboot, verified etcd auto-started (enabled via systemctl enable), rejoined the cluster, and matched the cluster-wide raft applied index, with both test keys intact and endpoint health true on all endpoints

evidence.requirement: 3-member etcd cluster formed and healthy
evidence.summary: member list shows 3 started members (node1/node2/node3); endpoint health true for all 3; endpoint status shows matching raft term/index across all members

evidence.requirement: Key written on one member is readable from the others
evidence.summary: 'benchkey' written via node1's endpoint, then read back with identical value from node2 and node3 endpoints

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node3's etcd stopped (inactive); write 'duringoutage' succeeded via node1 with 2/2 remaining endpoints healthy; value read back successfully via node2

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member catches up and rejoins when brought back
evidence.summary: node3 etcd restarted; after rejoining, node3 endpoint returns both 'benchkey' and 'duringoutage' and its raft applied index (17) matches node1 and node2 exactly, with member list showing all 3 as started

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id c207ab79-..., uptime since 20:12:13, etcd active, and both keys readable on node1 before restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot command acked before disconnect; connection reset confirmed the node went down; new boot_id c1e74bd7-... (changed from baseline) proves a real reboot; post-restart etcd active with cluster fully healthy at matching raft index 18 across all members and both keys present

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 1b0321bf-..., uptime since 20:12:13, etcd active, and both keys readable on node2 before restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot command acked before disconnect; connection timeout confirmed the node was down mid-reboot; new boot_id c81d90a3-... (changed from baseline) proves a real reboot; post-restart etcd active with cluster healthy at matching raft index 23 across all members (new leader elected, term 3) and both keys present

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id f38484ef-... (post earlier outage-recovery reboot cycle), uptime since 20:12:13, etcd active, and both keys readable on node3 before this restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot command acked before disconnect; connection reset confirmed the node went down; new boot_id 3b4452ee-... (changed from baseline) proves a real reboot; post-restart etcd active with full 3/3 cluster health, matching raft applied index 28 on all members, and both keys present
